name: time-split
title: Time Split
description: A total time on a raised panel, its split shown as coloured segments along the panel's curved bottom edge.

perf.budget: Segments trim one path on UI-thread springs on arrival and on change; the time re-renders only while it counts. Nothing animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Segments take their lengths and the time changes without gliding or counting.
a11y.screenReader: One label with the total and every item ("Studio Hours: 4 hours 36 minutes. Coding 2 hours 30 minutes, Reading 1 hour 1 minute.").
